name: Kiki-ArmorDebufRemover
teaser: Adds a config file which gives the option to edit the mouse aim / ergonomic / speed penalties from armor, rigs and helmets.
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
ReadMe.

This mod allows you to set the mouse aim, movement speed, or ergonomic penalty penalty of armor, rigs or helmets a % of your choosing.
At 0 they will be removed completely. 0.5, halved. 2, doubled. For example.
Set the options you want in config.json.

Thanks to X.Fight for the suggestion, and as always to Ereshkigal for the mod framework.

Credit to MM_SK for changing the config to a % based system.

If you love what I do, why not buy me a coffee?

Install instructions.

Open the zip with winzip/winrar/7zip etc, and drag the containing folder into the main folder of your AKI install.
